text.en: identifying, naming, describing and classifying 3D shapes: cube, cuboid, cone, cylinder, sphere
text.zh: 认识、说出名称、描述和分类立体图形：正方体、长方体、圆锥、圆柱、球

text.en: identifying 2D representations of cube, cuboid, cone, cylinder, prism, pyramid
text.zh: 认识正方体、长方体、圆锥、圆柱、棱柱、棱锥的平面表示

text.en: drawing 2D representations of cube, cuboid, prism, pyramid
text.zh: 画出正方体、长方体、棱柱、棱锥的平面表示

text.en: identifying the nets of 3D solids: cube, cuboid, prism, pyramid
text.zh: 认识立体图形的展开图：正方体、长方体、棱柱、棱锥

text.en: identifying the solid which can be formed by a given net
text.zh: 认出给定的展开图能折成的立体

caption.en: You have met these solids before: a cube, a cuboid, a cylinder, a cone and a sphere. A solid takes up space. You can hold it and turn it round.
caption.zh: 这些立体你见过：正方体、长方体、圆柱、圆锥和球。立体占着空间，可以拿在手里转着看。

caption.en: Each flat side of a solid is a face. Turn the cube and count: top, bottom, front, back, left and right. A cube has 6 faces, all squares of the same size.
caption.zh: 立体上每一块平平的面叫作面。把正方体转着数：上、下、前、后、左、右。正方体有 6 个面，都是一样大的正方形。

caption.en: A cuboid has 6 faces too, but they are rectangles. They come in 3 pairs: each face has a twin of the same size on the opposite side.
caption.zh: 长方体也有 6 个面，但面是长方形。它们成 3 对：每个面在对面都有一个一样大的。

caption.en: Some faces are curved. A cylinder has 2 flat faces that are circles and 1 curved face. A cone has 1 flat circle and 1 curved face. A sphere has only a curved face.
caption.zh: 有的面是弯的。圆柱有 2 个圆形的平的面和 1 个曲面；圆锥有 1 个圆形的平的面和 1 个曲面；球只有一个曲面。

keyFacts.en: A face is a flat or curved side of a solid.
keyFacts.zh: 面是立体上平的或弯的那一块。

keyFacts.en: A cube has 6 faces, all equal squares.
keyFacts.zh: 正方体有 6 个面，都是一样大的正方形。

keyFacts.en: A cuboid has 6 rectangle faces in 3 pairs.
keyFacts.zh: 长方体有 6 个长方形的面，成 3 对。

prompt.en: Siti is sorting a box of building blocks. What is this block called?
prompt.zh: Siti 在整理一盒积木。这块积木叫什么？

guide.en: Turn the block with the arrows and look at its faces: their shape, and whether they are all the same size.
guide.zh: 用箭头按钮转一转积木，看它的面：是什么形状，是不是一样大。

hints.en: Look at the top face. Is it a square?
hints.zh: 看上面那个面。它是正方形吗？

hints.en: The faces are rectangles, in 3 pairs.
hints.zh: 面是长方形，成 3 对。

correct.en: Yes. Its 6 faces are rectangles in 3 pairs, so it is a cuboid.
correct.zh: 对。它的 6 个面是长方形，成 3 对，所以是长方体。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look at the shape of each face, and count the faces.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看看每个面是什么形状，再数一数有几个面。

reveal.en: The block has 6 flat faces. They are rectangles, not all the same size: it is a cuboid.
reveal.zh: 这块积木有 6 个平的面，都是长方形，大小不全一样：它是长方体。

say.en: Look at the faces: a cube has 6 squares all the same size. This box has rectangles on its sides, so it is a cuboid.
say.zh: 看面：正方体的 6 个面是一样大的正方形。这个盒子侧面是长方形，所以是长方体。

prompt.en: Siti finds a tall block with two square ends. What is this solid called?
prompt.zh: Siti 找到一块高高的积木，两头是正方形。这个立体叫什么？

guide.en: Two faces are squares. Look at the other four before you decide.
guide.zh: 有两个面是正方形。先看看另外四个面，再决定。

hints.en: Turn it round. Are the long faces squares?
hints.zh: 把它转一转。长长的那几个面是正方形吗？

hints.en: A cube needs all 6 faces to be equal squares.
hints.zh: 正方体要 6 个面都是一样大的正方形。

correct.en: Yes. Only its two ends are squares; its four sides are rectangles, so it is a cuboid.
correct.zh: 对。只有两头是正方形，四个侧面是长方形，所以是长方体。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look at the shape of each face, and count the faces.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看看每个面是什么形状，再数一数有几个面。

reveal.en: The two ends are squares, but the four long faces are rectangles. Not all 6 faces are equal squares, so it is a cuboid, not a cube.
reveal.zh: 两头是正方形，可是四个长面是长方形。6 个面不全是一样大的正方形，所以是长方体，不是正方体。

say.en: Look at all 6 faces: the two ends are squares, but the four sides are long rectangles. A cube has 6 equal squares, so this block is a cuboid.
say.zh: 6 个面都看看：两头是正方形，四个侧面却是长方形。正方体的 6 个面是一样大的正方形，所以这块积木是长方体。

prompt.en: This block comes to a point at the top. What is it called?
prompt.zh: 这块积木顶上是一个尖。它叫什么？

guide.en: Look at the face it stands on, and at the face that goes up to the point.
guide.zh: 看它立着的那个面，和一直通到尖上的那个面。

hints.en: The face it stands on is a circle.
hints.zh: 它立着的那个面是圆形。

hints.en: The face going up to the point is curved, not made of triangles.
hints.zh: 通到尖上的那个面是弯的，不是由三角形拼成的。

correct.en: Yes. A flat circle and one curved face that comes to a point: it is a cone.
correct.zh: 对。一个圆形的平的面，加一个收到尖上的曲面：它是圆锥。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look at the shape of each face, and count the faces.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看看每个面是什么形状，再数一数有几个面。

reveal.en: It stands on a circle, and one curved face goes up to the point. That is a cone.
reveal.zh: 它立在一个圆上，一个曲面一直收到尖上。这是圆锥。

say.en: A pyramid also has a point, but its faces are flat triangles. This solid has one curved face round a circle, so it is a cone.
say.zh: 棱锥也有尖，但它的面是平平的三角形。这个立体是绕着一个圆的曲面，所以是圆锥。

prompt.en: What is this block called?
prompt.zh: 这块积木叫什么？

guide.en: Turn the block and look at all its faces. Are they the same shape and size?
guide.zh: 把积木转一转，看看它所有的面。形状、大小都一样吗？

hints.en: Look at the top face and a side face. Are they the same size?
hints.zh: 看上面的面和侧面的面。它们一样大吗？

hints.en: All 6 faces are squares of the same size.
hints.zh: 6 个面都是一样大的正方形。

correct.en: Yes. All 6 faces are squares of the same size, so it is a cube.
correct.zh: 对。6 个面都是一样大的正方形，所以是正方体。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look at the shape of each face, and count the faces.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看看每个面是什么形状，再数一数有几个面。

reveal.en: Every face is a square, and all 6 are the same size: it is a cube.
reveal.zh: 每个面都是正方形，6 个一样大：它是正方体。

say.en: Look at the faces: every one is a square, and all 6 are the same size. That makes it a cube. A cuboid has rectangles on some of its faces.
say.zh: 看面：每个面都是正方形，6 个一样大，所以是正方体。长方体至少有几个面是长方形。

prompt.en: How many faces does a cube have?
prompt.zh: 正方体有几个面？

guide.en: Turn the cube and count every face once: the ones you can see, and the ones at the back.
guide.zh: 把正方体转一转，每个面数一次：看得见的，还有背后的。

hints.en: You can see 3 faces at a time. Turn it to see the others.
hints.zh: 一次只看得见 3 个面。转过去看另外几个。

hints.en: Count top, bottom, front, back, left, right.
hints.zh: 数：上、下、前、后、左、右。

correct.en: Yes. Top, bottom, front, back, left and right: 6 faces, all equal squares.
correct.zh: 对。上、下、前、后、左、右：6 个面，都是一样大的正方形。

fallback.en: Not yet. Only 3 faces show at once. Turn the cube and count the hidden ones too.
fallback.zh: 还没对。一次只看得见 3 个面。把正方体转过来，把藏着的也数上。

reveal.en: A cube has 6 faces: top, bottom, front, back, left and right.
reveal.zh: 正方体有 6 个面：上、下、前、后、左、右。

prompt.en: Ravi holds a cuboid-shaped pencil box. How many faces does it have?
prompt.zh: Ravi 拿着一个长方体的铅笔盒。它有几个面？

guide.en: Each face has a twin on the opposite side. Count the pairs, or count every face once.
guide.zh: 每个面在对面都有一个一样大的。数有几对，或者每个面数一次。

hints.en: Turn it round: some faces are at the back.
hints.zh: 把它转过来：有的面在背后。

hints.en: There are 3 pairs of faces.
hints.zh: 面有 3 对。

correct.en: Yes. 3 pairs of rectangles: 6 faces, the same number as a cube.
correct.zh: 对。3 对长方形：6 个面，和正方体一样多。

fallback.en: Not yet. Turn the box and count the faces at the back and underneath too.
fallback.zh: 还没对。把盒子转过来，背后和底下的面也要数。

reveal.en: A cuboid has 6 faces in 3 pairs: top and bottom, front and back, left and right.
reveal.zh: 长方体有 6 个面，成 3 对：上和下、前和后、左和右。

prompt.en: How many flat faces does this cylinder have?
prompt.zh: 这个圆柱有几个平的面？

guide.en: A flat face could lie flat on a table. The curved face would roll.
guide.zh: 平的面能平放在桌上；曲面放上去会滚。

hints.en: Look at the two ends.
hints.zh: 看两头。

hints.en: The ends are circles, and they are flat.
hints.zh: 两头是圆，是平的。

correct.en: Yes. The two circles at the ends are flat; the face between them is curved.
correct.zh: 对。两头的圆是平的，中间那个面是弯的。

fallback.en: Not yet. Count only the faces that are flat. The face round the side is curved.
fallback.zh: 还没对。只数平的面。侧面那一圈是弯的。

reveal.en: A cylinder has 2 flat faces, the circles at its ends, and 1 curved face.
reveal.zh: 圆柱有 2 个平的面，就是两头的圆，还有 1 个曲面。

say.en: Count again. There is a flat circle at each end, so 2 flat faces. The face round the side is curved, so it is not counted.
say.zh: 再数一数。两头各有一个平的圆，所以有 2 个平的面。侧面那一圈是弯的，不算。

prompt.en: How many flat faces does this cone have?
prompt.zh: 这个圆锥有几个平的面？

guide.en: Look for faces that could lie flat on a table.
guide.zh: 找一找能平放在桌上的面。

hints.en: Look at the face the cone stands on.
hints.zh: 看圆锥立着的那个面。

hints.en: The face going up to the point is curved.
hints.zh: 通到尖上的那个面是弯的。

correct.en: Yes. Only the circle it stands on is flat; the rest is one curved face.
correct.zh: 对。只有它立着的那个圆是平的，其余是一个曲面。

fallback.en: Not yet. Count only flat faces. The point is not a face, and the side is curved.
fallback.zh: 还没对。只数平的面。尖不是面，侧面是弯的。

reveal.en: A cone has 1 flat face, the circle at the bottom, and 1 curved face.
reveal.zh: 圆锥有 1 个平的面，就是底下的圆，还有 1 个曲面。

say.en: Count again. Only the circle the cone stands on is flat. The point is not a face, and the face going up to it is curved.
say.zh: 再数一数。只有圆锥立着的那个圆是平的。尖不是面，通到尖上的那个面是弯的。

prompt.en: Mei Ling's pencil box is a cuboid. Which of these blocks are cuboids too? Choose all of them.
prompt.zh: Mei Ling 的铅笔盒是长方体。下面哪些积木也是长方体？全部选出来。

guide.en: A cuboid has 6 flat faces that are rectangles; one pair may be squares. A cube has 6 equal squares.
guide.zh: 长方体的 6 个平的面是长方形，其中一对可以是正方形。正方体是 6 个一样大的正方形。

hints.en: Turn each block. Are all its faces equal squares?
hints.zh: 把每块积木转一转。是不是所有的面都是一样大的正方形？

hints.en: Two of the blocks are cubes.
hints.zh: 有两块是正方体。

correct.en: Yes. Both blocks with rectangle faces are cuboids, even the one with square ends.
correct.zh: 对。有长方形面的两块都是长方体，两头是正方形的那块也是。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look at the faces of each block: a cuboid has some rectangle faces.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看每块积木的面：长方体有长方形的面。

reveal.en: The tall block with square ends and the long thin block are cuboids. The other two have 6 equal squares, so they are cubes.
reveal.zh: 两头是正方形的高积木和细长的积木是长方体。另外两块的 6 个面是一样大的正方形，是正方体。

say.en: That block has 6 equal squares, so it is a cube, not a cuboid. Choose the blocks with rectangle faces.
say.zh: 那块积木的 6 个面是一样大的正方形，所以是正方体，不是长方体。选有长方形面的积木。

prompt.en: Wei Jie's block is a cube. Which of these blocks are cubes too? Choose all of them.
prompt.zh: Wei Jie 的积木是正方体。下面哪些积木也是正方体？全部选出来。

guide.en: A cube has 6 faces, all squares of the same size. Size does not matter: a big cube is still a cube.
guide.zh: 正方体有 6 个面，都是一样大的正方形。大小没关系：大的正方体还是正方体。

hints.en: Turn the blocks. Are all the faces squares?
hints.zh: 把积木转一转。是不是所有的面都是正方形？

hints.en: Two blocks have some faces that are not squares.
hints.zh: 有两块积木，有些面不是正方形。

correct.en: Yes. Both blocks with 6 equal squares are cubes, the big one and the small one.
correct.zh: 对。6 个面都是一样大正方形的两块都是正方体，大的小的都是。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look for blocks whose 6 faces are all equal squares.
fallback.zh: 还没对。找 6 个面都是一样大正方形的积木。

reveal.en: The big and the small block with 6 equal squares are cubes. The flat block and the tall block have rectangle faces, so they are cuboids.
reveal.zh: 6 个面都是一样大正方形的大积木和小积木是正方体。扁的和高的那两块有长方形的面，是长方体。

say.en: That block has squares on two faces, but its other faces are rectangles. A cube needs 6 equal squares, so it is a cuboid.
say.zh: 那块积木有两个面是正方形，可其他面是长方形。正方体要 6 个一样大的正方形，所以它是长方体。

caption.en: Imagine a cube made of card. Cut along some of its edges, and it can open out flat.
caption.zh: 想象一个用卡纸做的正方体。沿着几条棱剪开，它就能摊平。

caption.en: The faces stay joined along the edges you did not cut. Each face turns about its edge, like a door turning on its hinge.
caption.zh: 没剪开的棱还连着。每个面绕着自己那条棱转，像门绕着门轴转。

caption.en: Flat on the table, the cube is 6 squares joined edge to edge. This flat shape is a net of the cube.
caption.zh: 摊平在桌上，正方体变成 6 个边挨着边的正方形。这个平面图形叫作正方体的展开图。

caption.en: Fold it back along the same edges and the 6 squares close up into a cube again. A net is a flat shape that folds up into a solid.
caption.zh: 沿着同样的棱折回去，6 个正方形又合成正方体。展开图是能折成立体的平面图形。

keyFacts.en: A net is a flat shape that folds up into a solid.
keyFacts.zh: 展开图是能折成立体的平面图形。

keyFacts.en: A net of a cube has 6 squares joined edge to edge.
keyFacts.zh: 正方体的展开图是 6 个边挨着边的正方形。

keyFacts.en: You fold along the edges.
keyFacts.zh: 沿着棱折。

prompt.en: Aisha cut a card box open and laid it flat. What solid will this net fold up into?
prompt.zh: Aisha 把一个卡纸盒剪开摊平。这个展开图能折成什么立体？

guide.en: Look at the pieces: their shape, their size and how many there are.
guide.zh: 看这些块：什么形状、多大、有几块。

hints.en: Count the squares. Are they all the same size?
hints.zh: 数一数正方形。它们一样大吗？

hints.en: 6 equal squares make 6 equal faces.
hints.zh: 6 个一样大的正方形，折成 6 个一样大的面。

correct.en: Yes. 6 equal squares fold up into a cube.
correct.zh: 对。6 个一样大的正方形折成正方体。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look at the shape of each face, and count the faces.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看看每个面是什么形状，再数一数有几个面。

reveal.en: The net is 6 equal squares, so folded up it is a cube.
reveal.zh: 展开图是 6 个一样大的正方形，折起来是正方体。

say.en: A cuboid's net has rectangles. Here every piece is a square of the same size, so it folds into a cube.
say.zh: 长方体的展开图里有长方形。这里每一块都是一样大的正方形，所以折成正方体。

prompt.en: What solid will this net fold up into?
prompt.zh: 这个展开图能折成什么立体？

guide.en: It does not look like a cross. Look at the shape and size of every piece.
guide.zh: 它不像十字形。看看每一块的形状和大小。

hints.en: Are all the pieces squares of the same size?
hints.zh: 每一块都是一样大的正方形吗？

hints.en: There are 6 equal squares.
hints.zh: 有 6 个一样大的正方形。

correct.en: Yes. 6 equal squares fold up into a cube, even though the net is not a cross.
correct.zh: 对。6 个一样大的正方形折成正方体，虽然这个展开图不是十字形。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look at the shape of each face, and count the faces.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看看每个面是什么形状，再数一数有几个面。

reveal.en: All 6 pieces are equal squares, so it folds up into a cube.
reveal.zh: 6 块都是一样大的正方形，所以折成正方体。

say.en: A cuboid's net has rectangles. Every piece here is the same square, so the solid is a cube.
say.zh: 长方体的展开图里有长方形。这里每一块都是同样的正方形，所以是正方体。

prompt.en: Arjun drew this net on squared paper. What solid will it fold up into?
prompt.zh: Arjun 在方格纸上画了这个展开图。它能折成什么立体？

guide.en: Count the squares along the sides of each piece. Are all the pieces squares?
guide.zh: 数一数每一块的边有几格。每一块都是正方形吗？

hints.en: The middle piece is 2 by 2. What about the pieces round it?
hints.zh: 中间那块是 2 × 2。四周那几块呢？

hints.en: Four pieces are 2 by 1 rectangles.
hints.zh: 有四块是 2 × 1 的长方形。

correct.en: Yes. Two 2 by 2 squares and four 2 by 1 rectangles fold up into a cuboid.
correct.zh: 对。两个 2 × 2 的正方形和四个 2 × 1 的长方形折成长方体。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look at the shape of each face, and count the faces.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看看每个面是什么形状，再数一数有几个面。

reveal.en: Four of the pieces are rectangles, so the solid is a cuboid.
reveal.zh: 有四块是长方形，所以立体是长方体。

say.en: Two pieces are squares, but four are 2 by 1 rectangles. A cube needs 6 equal squares, so this one folds into a cuboid.
say.zh: 有两块是正方形，可另外四块是 2 × 1 的长方形。正方体要 6 个一样大的正方形，所以这个折成长方体。

prompt.en: Which of these is a net of the cube?
prompt.zh: 哪一个是这个正方体的展开图？

guide.en: A net of a cube is flat, and it has one square for each face of the cube.
guide.zh: 正方体的展开图是平的，正方体的每个面都有一个正方形。

hints.en: Count the squares in each picture.
hints.zh: 数一数每幅图里有几个正方形。

hints.en: The cube has 6 faces, so look for 6 squares.
hints.zh: 正方体有 6 个面，所以找 6 个正方形的。

correct.en: Yes. 6 squares, one for each face: it folds up into the cube.
correct.zh: 对。6 个正方形，每个面一个：它能折成这个正方体。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look for a flat shape of 6 squares, one for each face.
fallback.zh: 还没对。找一个由 6 个正方形组成的平面图形，每个面一个。

reveal.en: The cross of 6 squares folds up into the cube. The others have 5 or 7 squares.
reveal.zh: 6 个正方形的十字形能折成这个正方体。其他的有 5 个或 7 个正方形。

say.en: A cube has 6 faces, so its net needs 6 squares. This one has 5: the box would have no lid.
say.zh: 正方体有 6 个面，展开图要 6 个正方形。这里只有 5 个：盒子会没有盖。

prompt.en: Daniel wants to make this cube from card. Which net should he cut out?
prompt.zh: Daniel 想用卡纸做这个正方体。他应该剪下哪一个展开图？

guide.en: Count the squares first. Then picture folding the ones with the right number.
guide.zh: 先数正方形，再在脑子里折一折个数对的那几个。

hints.en: A cube has 6 faces.
hints.zh: 正方体有 6 个面。

hints.en: Two of the pictures have 6 squares. Does each one cover every face?
hints.zh: 有两幅图是 6 个正方形。它们能盖住每个面吗？

correct.en: Yes. Its 6 squares cover the 6 faces once each.
correct.zh: 对。它的 6 个正方形正好把 6 个面各盖一次。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look for 6 squares that fold up with no face covered twice.

caption.en: Here both extra squares are on the same side of the row of 4. Folded, they both close the same end, and the other end stays open.
caption.zh: 这里两个多出来的正方形在 4 个一排的同一边。折起来，它俩盖住同一头，另一头空着。

caption.en: Quick signs of a non-net: a 2 by 2 block, 5 in a row, or two squares on the same side of a row of 4. Some non-nets show none of these, so fold to be sure.
caption.zh: 看到 2 × 2 的方块、一排 5 个、或者 4 个一排的同一边有两个，就不是展开图。有的不是展开图却没有这些记号，所以要折一折才确定。

keyFacts.en: A cube net needs 6 squares, but not every 6 squares make a net.
keyFacts.zh: 正方体的展开图要 6 个正方形，但不是随便 6 个都行。

keyFacts.en: If two squares land on the same face when folded, it is not a net.
keyFacts.zh: 折起来有两个正方形叠在同一个面上，就不是展开图。

keyFacts.en: The quick signs help, but fold it to be sure.
keyFacts.zh: 快速记号有用，要确定还得折一折。

prompt.en: Will these 6 squares fold up into a cube?
prompt.zh: 这 6 个正方形能折成正方体吗？

guide.en: Choose a bottom, fold up the sides, then close the top. Does every face get exactly one square?
guide.zh: 先选一个底，把四周折起来，最后盖上顶。是不是每个面都正好有一个正方形？

hints.en: Choose one square as the bottom.
hints.zh: 先选一个正方形当底。

hints.en: Fold the squares next to it up. Where does the last one go?
hints.zh: 把挨着它的折起来。最后一个落在哪？

hints.en: Use the FOLD slider to watch it fold.
hints.zh: 用 FOLD 滑块看它折起来。

correct.en: Yes. It does not fold up. The 2 by 2 block puts two squares on one face, and another face stays open.
correct.zh: 对，不能。2 × 2 的方块让两个正方形落在同一个面上，另一个面空着。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look at the four squares in a block. Only 3 faces of a cube meet at a corner.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看看拼成一块的那四个正方形。正方体的一个角上只有 3 个面相接。

reveal.en: It does not fold up: the 2 by 2 block makes two squares land on the same face.
reveal.zh: 不能折成：2 × 2 的方块让两个正方形落在同一个面上。

say.en: There are 6 squares, but fold it and look: two of them land on the same face, and one face is left open.
say.zh: 确实有 6 个正方形，可是折一折看：有两个叠在同一个面上，另一个面空着。

prompt.en: Will these 6 squares fold up into a cube?
prompt.zh: 这 6 个正方形能折成正方体吗？

guide.en: Choose a bottom, fold up the sides, then close the top. Does every face get exactly one square?
guide.zh: 先选一个底，把四周折起来，最后盖上顶。是不是每个面都正好有一个正方形？

hints.en: Choose one square as the bottom.
hints.zh: 先选一个正方形当底。

hints.en: Fold the squares next to it up. Where does the last one go?
hints.zh: 把挨着它的折起来。最后一个落在哪？

hints.en: Use the FOLD slider to watch it fold.
hints.zh: 用 FOLD 滑块看它折起来。

correct.en: Yes. It does not fold up. Both extra squares close the same end of the ring, and the other end stays open.
correct.zh: 对，不能。两个多出来的正方形盖住这一圈的同一头，另一头空着。

fallback.en: Not yet. Fold the row of 4 into a ring. Which ends do the other two squares close?
fallback.zh: 还没对。把一排 4 个折成一圈。另外两个正方形盖住哪一头？

reveal.en: It does not fold up: two squares on the same side of a row of 4 close the same end.
reveal.zh: 不能折成：4 个一排的同一边有两个，它们盖住同一头。

say.en: There are 6 squares, but fold it and look: two of them land on the same face, and one face is left open.
say.zh: 确实有 6 个正方形，可是折一折看：有两个叠在同一个面上，另一个面空着。

prompt.en: Will these 6 squares fold up into a cube?
prompt.zh: 这 6 个正方形能折成正方体吗？

guide.en: Choose a bottom, fold up the sides, then close the top. Does every face get exactly one square?
guide.zh: 先选一个底，把四周折起来，最后盖上顶。是不是每个面都正好有一个正方形？

hints.en: Choose one square as the bottom.
hints.zh: 先选一个正方形当底。

hints.en: Fold the squares next to it up. Where does the last one go?
hints.zh: 把挨着它的折起来。最后一个落在哪？

hints.en: Use the FOLD slider to watch it fold.
hints.zh: 用 FOLD 滑块看它折起来。

correct.en: Yes. It does not fold up. It has none of the quick signs, but folded, two squares land on the same face.
correct.zh: 对，不能。它没有那几个快速记号，可是折起来，有两个正方形落在同一个面上。

fallback.en: Not yet. No quick sign shows here, so fold it to be sure: choose a bottom, fold up the sides, then close the top.
fallback.zh: 还没对。这里看不出快速记号，所以要折一折才确定：先选一个底，把四周折起来，最后盖上顶。

reveal.en: It does not fold up: two of its squares land on the same face, and one face is left open.
reveal.zh: 不能折成：有两个正方形落在同一个面上，另一个面空着。

say.en: There are 6 squares, but fold it and look: two of them land on the same face, and one face is left open.
say.zh: 确实有 6 个正方形，可是折一折看：有两个叠在同一个面上，另一个面空着。

prompt.en: Will this net fold up into a cube?
prompt.zh: 这个展开图能折成正方体吗？

guide.en: Choose a bottom, fold up the sides, then close the top. Does every face get exactly one square?
guide.zh: 先选一个底，把四周折起来，最后盖上顶。是不是每个面都正好有一个正方形？

hints.en: Choose one square as the bottom.
hints.zh: 先选一个正方形当底。

hints.en: Fold the squares next to it up. Where does the last one go?
hints.zh: 把挨着它的折起来。最后一个落在哪？

hints.en: Use the FOLD slider to watch it fold.
hints.zh: 用 FOLD 滑块看它折起来。

correct.en: Yes. It has no row of 4, but every face gets exactly one square.
correct.zh: 对。它没有 4 个一排，可是每个面都正好有一个正方形。

fallback.en: Not yet. None of the quick signs is here. Fold it in your head before you decide.
fallback.zh: 还没对。这里没有那几个快速记号。先在脑子里折一折，再决定。

reveal.en: It folds up into a cube: 2 squares, then 3, then 1 is one of the 11 nets.
reveal.zh: 能折成正方体：2 个、3 个、1 个的排法是 11 种展开图之一。

say.en: This one does not look like the cross, but fold it: choose a bottom, fold up the sides, then close the top. All 6 faces are covered.
say.zh: 它不像十字形，但折一折：先选一个底，把四周折起来，最后盖上顶，6 个面都盖住了。

prompt.en: Only one of these folds up into the cube. Which one?
prompt.zh: 下面只有一个能折成这个正方体。是哪一个？

guide.en: All four have 6 squares, so counting will not help. Look for the quick signs, then fold the one left.
guide.zh: 四幅图都是 6 个正方形，数个数没用。先找快速记号，再把剩下的折一折。

hints.en: One picture has 5 in a row. One has two squares on the same side of a row of 4.
hints.zh: 有一幅是一排 5 个，有一幅在 4 个一排的同一边有两个。

hints.en: Of the other two, fold each one: which one covers every face once?
hints.zh: 另外两幅，各折一折：哪一个正好把每个面盖一次？

correct.en: Yes. It folds up with every face covered once.
correct.zh: 对。它折起来，每个面都正好盖住一次。

fallback.en: Not yet. That one has two squares on one face when folded. Fold the others.
fallback.zh: 还没对。那一个折起来有两个正方形在同一个面上。折折别的。

reveal.en: The net with 2 squares, then 3, then 1 folds up. The others each put two squares on one face.
reveal.zh: 2 个、3 个、1 个的那个能折成。其他的都有两个正方形落在同一个面上。

say.en: There are 6 squares, but fold it and look: two of them land on the same face, and one face is left open.
say.zh: 确实有 6 个正方形，可是折一折看：有两个叠在同一个面上，另一个面空着。

prompt.en: Only one of these folds up into the cube. Which one?
prompt.zh: 下面只有一个能折成这个正方体。是哪一个？

guide.en: Every picture has 6 squares. Rule out the ones with a quick sign, then fold the rest in your head.
guide.zh: 每幅图都是 6 个正方形。先排除有快速记号的，再在脑子里折剩下的。

hints.en: Look for a 2 by 2 block.
hints.zh: 找一找 2 × 2 的方块。

hints.en: The net that folds has no row longer than 3.
hints.zh: 能折成的那个，最长一排不超过 3 个。

correct.en: Yes. Two rows of 3, side by side, fold up into the cube.
correct.zh: 对。两排 3 个错开，能折成这个正方体。

fallback.en: Not yet. Folded, that one has two squares on one face. Try another.
fallback.zh: 还没对。那一个折起来有两个正方形在同一个面上。换一个试试。

reveal.en: Two rows of 3, side by side, is a net. The others each put two squares on one face.
reveal.zh: 两排 3 个错开的是展开图。其他的都有两个正方形落在同一个面上。

say.en: There are 6 squares, but fold it and look: two of them land on the same face, and one face is left open.
say.zh: 确实有 6 个正方形，可是折一折看：有两个叠在同一个面上，另一个面空着。

prompt.en: Choose a place for the last square so that the net folds up into a cube.
prompt.zh: 给最后一个正方形选个位置，让展开图能折成正方体。

guide.en: The row of 4 wraps round. One end is closed already. Which places close the other end?
guide.zh: 一排 4 个绕成一圈，一头已经盖上了。哪些位置能盖住另一头？

hints.en: The square above the row closes one end.
hints.zh: 一排上面的正方形盖住一头。

hints.en: Two squares on the same side of a row of 4 close the same end.
hints.zh: 4 个一排的同一边有两个，就会盖住同一头。

correct.en: Yes. Any place below the row closes the other end.
correct.zh: 对。一排下面的任何一个位置都能盖住另一头。

fallback.en: Not yet. Folded, that square lands on a face that is covered already. Try the other side of the row.
fallback.zh: 还没对。折起来，那个正方形落在已经盖住的面上。试试一排的另一边。

reveal.en: A square below the row of 4 closes the open end: any one of those places works.
reveal.zh: 在一排 4 个的下面加一个，就盖住了空着的那头：那几个位置任选一个都行。

say.en: There are 6 squares, but fold it and look: this square and the one above the row both close the same end, and the other end is left open.
say.zh: 有 6 个正方形，可是折一折看：这个正方形和一排上面那个盖住同一头，另一头空着。

prompt.en: Kumar needs one more square. Which place makes a net of a cube?
prompt.zh: Kumar 还差一个正方形。放在哪里能成为正方体的展开图？

guide.en: Fold the 5 squares in your head. Then check each place: does it close the open face, or land on a face that is covered?
guide.zh: 在脑子里折这 5 个正方形。再看每个位置：是盖住空着的面，还是落在已经盖住的面上？

hints.en: One place makes a 2 by 2 block.
hints.zh: 有一个位置会拼出 2 × 2 的方块。

hints.en: One place shows no quick sign, but folded, two squares land on one face.
hints.zh: 有一个位置看不出快速记号，可是折起来有两个正方形落在同一个面上。

hints.en: Try making two rows of 3, side by side.
hints.zh: 试试拼成两排 3 个错开。

correct.en: Yes. It makes two rows of 3, side by side: one of the 11 nets.
correct.zh: 对。这样就成了两排 3 个错开，是 11 种展开图之一。

fallback.en: Not yet. Folded, two squares land on one face. Try another place.
fallback.zh: 还没对。折起来有两个正方形落在同一个面上。换个位置。

reveal.en: The square at the top of the right-hand column makes two rows of 3, side by side.
reveal.zh: 接在右边那一列的最上面，就成了两排 3 个错开。

say.en: There are 6 squares, and no quick sign shows. But fold it and look: two of them land on the same face, and one face is left open.
say.zh: 有 6 个正方形，也看不出快速记号。可是折一折看：有两个叠在同一个面上，另一个面空着。

prompt.en: Add one square next to the others so that the net folds up into a cube.
prompt.zh: 在旁边加一个正方形，让展开图能折成正方体。

guide.en: Fold the 5 squares in your head and find the face that is still open.
guide.zh: 在脑子里折这 5 个正方形，找出还空着的面。

hints.en: The row of 3 makes three sides of the cube. One more side is needed.
hints.zh: 一排 3 个围成正方体的三个侧面，还差一个侧面。

hints.en: The fourth side hangs on the end of the row.
hints.zh: 第四个侧面接在这一排的尽头。

hints.en: Try the place to the right of the row, or to the right of the top square.
hints.zh: 试试一排右边的位置，或者最上面那个的右边。

correct.en: Yes. Any one of the places that closes the cube is right.
correct.zh: 对。任何一个能合拢的位置都对。

fallback.en: Not yet. Folded, the new square lands on a face that is covered already. Try another place.
fallback.zh: 还没对。折起来，新加的正方形落在已经盖住的面上。换个位置。

reveal.en: A square at the right end of the row of 3, or to the right of the top square, closes the cube.
reveal.zh: 接在一排 3 个的右端，或者接在最上面那个的右边，都能合拢。

say.en: There are 6 squares, but fold it and look: two of them land on the same face, and one face is left open.
say.zh: 有 6 个正方形，可是折一折看：有两个叠在同一个面上，另一个面空着。

prompt.en: Draw a net of a cube: add 2 squares on the paper so that it folds up.
prompt.zh: 画一个正方体的展开图：在方格纸上再加 2 个正方形，让它能折成。

guide.en: 4 squares are drawn. Fold them in your head: which two faces are still open?
guide.zh: 已经画了 4 个正方形。在脑子里折一折：还有哪两个面空着？

hints.en: The row of 3 wraps three sides. The square above it closes one end.
hints.zh: 一排 3 个围成三个侧面，上面那个盖住一头。

hints.en: One square is needed for the fourth side, and one for the other end.
hints.zh: 还要一个当第四个侧面，一个盖住另一头。

hints.en: Try one square at the end of the row and one below it.
hints.zh: 试试在一排的尽头加一个，在下面再加一个。

correct.en: Yes. Your net folds up with every face covered once. Any one of the right nets is right.
correct.zh: 对。你的展开图折起来，每个面都正好盖住一次。任何一种对的展开图都算对。

fallback.en: Not yet. Folded, two squares land on one face. Move one of your squares.
fallback.zh: 还没对。折起来有两个正方形落在同一个面上。挪一挪你画的正方形。

reveal.en: One answer: add a square at the right end of the row and one below the middle. Other nets work too.
reveal.zh: 一种答案：在一排的右端加一个，在中间下面加一个。别的展开图也行。

say.en: There are 6 squares, but fold it and look: two of them land on the same face, and one face is left open.
say.zh: 有 6 个正方形，可是折一折看：有两个叠在同一个面上，另一个面空着。

caption.en: Opposite faces never touch. On a cube, the top and bottom are opposite, so are the front and back, and the left and right.
caption.zh: 相对的两个面不相挨。正方体的上和下相对，前和后相对，左和右相对。

caption.en: Unfold the cube and keep the colours. In the row of 4, squares one apart are opposite: the 1st and 3rd, the 2nd and 4th.
caption.zh: 把正方体展开，颜色不变。在 4 个一排里，隔一个的两个相对：第 1 和第 3，第 2 和第 4。

caption.en: Squares that share an edge in the net always meet on the cube, so they can never be opposite.
caption.zh: 在展开图里共用一条边的两个正方形，折起来一定挨着，不可能相对。

words.zh: 底 = 空着那面的对面

caption.en: This net makes a box with no lid. The row of 4 wraps round as the sides, and the square at the end becomes the bottom. A bottom at the end is the hardest to spot.
caption.zh: 这个展开图折成没有盖的盒子。一排 4 个绕一圈当四周，尽头那个正方形当底。底在一端的最难看出来。

keyFacts.en: Opposite faces never touch.
keyFacts.zh: 相对的两个面不相挨。

keyFacts.en: In a straight row, squares one apart are opposite.
keyFacts.zh: 在一排里，隔一个的两个相对。

keyFacts.en: Squares that share an edge meet on the cube.
keyFacts.zh: 共用一条边的两个面，折起来挨着。

prompt.en: Tap the face that will be opposite the shaded face when the net is folded.
prompt.zh: 点出折起来以后和涂色的面相对的那个面。

guide.en: In a straight row, squares one apart are opposite.
guide.zh: 在一排里，隔一个的两个相对。

hints.en: The shaded square is in the row of 4.
hints.zh: 涂色的正方形在 4 个一排里。

hints.en: Skip one square along the row.
hints.zh: 沿着这一排隔一个。

correct.en: Yes. In the row of 4, the 2nd and 4th squares are opposite.
correct.zh: 对。在 4 个一排里，第 2 个和第 4 个相对。

fallback.en: Not yet. Opposite faces never touch. Look for a square that does not share an edge with the shaded one.
fallback.zh: 还没对。相对的两个面不相挨。找一个和涂色的面没有共用边的正方形。

reveal.en: The 4th square of the row is opposite the shaded 2nd square.
reveal.zh: 这一排的第 4 个和涂色的第 2 个相对。

say.en: These two squares share an edge, so they meet when folded. Opposite faces never touch: look one square further along the row.
say.zh: 这两个正方形共用一条边，折起来一定挨着。相对的两个面不相挨：沿着这一排再隔一个找。

prompt.en: Tap the face that will be opposite the shaded face when the net is folded.
prompt.zh: 点出折起来以后和涂色的面相对的那个面。

guide.en: The shaded square is not in the row. Fold the row into a ring first: which end does it close?
guide.zh: 涂色的正方形不在那一排里。先把一排折成一圈：它盖住哪一头？

hints.en: The shaded square closes one end of the ring.
hints.zh: 涂色的正方形盖住这一圈的一头。

hints.en: The face opposite it closes the other end.
hints.zh: 和它相对的面盖住另一头。

correct.en: Yes. The two squares off the row close the two ends of the ring, so they are opposite.
correct.zh: 对。不在那一排上的两个正方形盖住这一圈的两头，所以它们相对。

fallback.en: Not yet. Opposite faces never touch. Look for a square that does not share an edge with the shaded one.
fallback.zh: 还没对。相对的两个面不相挨。找一个和涂色的面没有共用边的正方形。

reveal.en: The square above the end of the row closes the other end, so it is opposite the shaded one.
reveal.zh: 接在一排尽头上面的那个盖住另一头，所以和涂色的那个相对。

say.en: These two squares share an edge, so they meet when folded. Opposite faces never touch: look one square further along the row.
say.zh: 这两个正方形共用一条边，折起来一定挨着。相对的两个面不相挨：沿着这一排再隔一个找。

prompt.en: Tap the face that will be opposite the shaded face when the net is folded.
prompt.zh: 点出折起来以后和涂色的面相对的那个面。

guide.en: In the row of 3, squares one apart are opposite.
guide.zh: 在 3 个一排里，隔一个的两个相对。

hints.en: The shaded square is the first of the row of 3.
hints.zh: 涂色的是 3 个一排的第 1 个。

hints.en: Skip one square along the row.
hints.zh: 沿着这一排隔一个。

correct.en: Yes. In the row of 3, the 1st and 3rd squares are opposite.
correct.zh: 对。在 3 个一排里，第 1 个和第 3 个相对。

fallback.en: Not yet. Opposite faces never touch. Look for a square that does not share an edge with the shaded one.
fallback.zh: 还没对。相对的两个面不相挨。找一个和涂色的面没有共用边的正方形。

reveal.en: The last square of the row of 3 is opposite the shaded one.
reveal.zh: 3 个一排的最后一个和涂色的那个相对。

say.en: These two squares share an edge, so they meet when folded. Opposite faces never touch: look one square further along the row.
say.zh: 这两个正方形共用一条边，折起来一定挨着。相对的两个面不相挨：沿着这一排再隔一个找。

prompt.en: Tap the face that will be opposite the shaded face when the net is folded.
prompt.zh: 点出折起来以后和涂色的面相对的那个面。

guide.en: In a straight row, squares one apart are opposite.
guide.zh: 在一排里，隔一个的两个相对。

hints.en: The shaded square is at the start of a row of 3.
hints.zh: 涂色的正方形在一排 3 个的开头。

hints.en: Skip one square along that row.
hints.zh: 沿着那一排隔一个。

correct.en: Yes. The 1st and 3rd squares of the row are opposite.
correct.zh: 对。这一排的第 1 个和第 3 个相对。

fallback.en: Not yet. Opposite faces never touch. Look for a square that does not share an edge with the shaded one.
fallback.zh: 还没对。相对的两个面不相挨。找一个和涂色的面没有共用边的正方形。

reveal.en: The 3rd square of the same row is opposite the shaded one.
reveal.zh: 同一排的第 3 个和涂色的那个相对。

say.en: These two squares share an edge, so they meet when folded. Opposite faces never touch: look one square further along the row.
say.zh: 这两个正方形共用一条边，折起来一定挨着。相对的两个面不相挨：沿着这一排再隔一个找。

prompt.en: Tap the face that will be opposite the shaded face when the net is folded.
prompt.zh: 点出折起来以后和涂色的面相对的那个面。

guide.en: There is no long row here. Fold it in your head: choose the shaded square as the bottom, and find the top.
guide.zh: 这里没有长的一排。在脑子里折一折：把涂色的当底，找出顶。

hints.en: The squares that share an edge with the shaded one become its sides.
hints.zh: 和涂色的共用一条边的，都成了它四周的面。

hints.en: The face opposite is the last one to close.
hints.zh: 和它相对的面，是最后盖上的那个。

hints.en: Look at the far end of the steps.
hints.zh: 看台阶的另一头。

correct.en: Yes. Folded with the shaded square as the bottom, that square closes the top.
correct.zh: 对。把涂色的当底折起来，那个正方形盖上了顶。

fallback.en: Not yet. Opposite faces never touch. Look for a square that does not share an edge with the shaded one.
fallback.zh: 还没对。相对的两个面不相挨。找一个和涂色的面没有共用边的正方形。

reveal.en: The square at the far end of the steps lands on top, opposite the shaded one.
reveal.zh: 台阶另一头的那个正方形落在顶上，和涂色的相对。

say.en: These two squares share an edge, so they meet when folded. Opposite faces never touch: look one square further along the row.
say.zh: 这两个正方形共用一条边，折起来一定挨着。相对的两个面不相挨：沿着这一排再隔一个找。

prompt.en: This net folds up into a box with no lid. Tap the bottom of the box.
prompt.zh: 这个展开图折成一个没有盖的盒子。点出盒子的底。

guide.en: The bottom touches all four sides of the box.
guide.zh: 底和盒子的四个侧面都挨着。

hints.en: Which square shares an edge with all the others?
hints.zh: 哪个正方形和其他每一个都共用一条边？

correct.en: Yes. The middle square is the bottom; the four round it fold up as the sides.
correct.zh: 对。中间那个是底，四周的四个折起来当侧面。

fallback.en: Not yet. That square folds up as a side. The bottom stays flat while the sides fold up round it.
fallback.zh: 还没对。那个正方形折起来是侧面。底不动，四周的折起来围着它。

reveal.en: The middle square is the bottom: the other four fold up round it.
reveal.zh: 中间那个是底：另外四个围着它折起来。

prompt.en: Farah's net folds up into a box with no lid. Tap the bottom of the box.
prompt.zh: Farah 的展开图折成一个没有盖的盒子。点出盒子的底。

guide.en: The row of 4 can wrap round as the four sides. Which square is left?
guide.zh: 一排 4 个可以绕一圈当四个侧面。剩下的是哪一个？

hints.en: The sides of a box make a ring.
hints.zh: 盒子的侧面围成一圈。

hints.en: The square that is not in the row closes one end of the ring.
hints.zh: 不在那一排里的正方形盖住这一圈的一头。

correct.en: Yes. The row of 4 wraps round as the sides, and the square at the end is the bottom.
correct.zh: 对。一排 4 个绕一圈当四周，尽头那个正方形是底。

fallback.en: Not yet. That square is part of the row of 4, which wraps round as the sides. Look at the square off the row.
fallback.zh: 还没对。那个正方形在 4 个一排里，这一排绕成四周。看看不在这一排里的那个。

reveal.en: The square at the end, off the row of 4, is the bottom; the row wraps round it as the sides.
reveal.zh: 尽头那个不在 4 个一排里的正方形是底，这一排绕着它围成四周。

prompt.en: Which letter will be opposite A when the net is folded up?
prompt.zh: 展开图折起来以后，哪个字母和 A 相对？

guide.en: Opposite faces never touch. Rule out every letter that shares an edge with A, or meets it when the row wraps round.
guide.zh: 相对的两个面不相挨。排除和 A 共用一条边的字母，还有一排绕起来时会和 A 碰上的。

hints.en: A is the first square of the row of 4.
hints.zh: A 是 4 个一排的第 1 个。

hints.en: In a row, squares one apart are opposite.
hints.zh: 在一排里，隔一个的两个相对。

correct.en: Yes. A and C are the 1st and 3rd squares of the row, one apart: they are opposite.
correct.zh: 对。A 和 C 是一排里的第 1 个和第 3 个，隔一个：它们相对。

fallback.en: Not yet. In the row of 4, skip one square after A.
fallback.zh: 还没对。在 4 个一排里，从 A 隔一个。

reveal.en: C is opposite A: they are the 1st and 3rd squares of the row of 4.
reveal.zh: C 和 A 相对：它们是 4 个一排的第 1 个和第 3 个。

say.en: B shares an edge with A, so they meet when folded. Opposite faces never touch: look one square further along the row.
say.zh: B 和 A 共用一条边，折起来一定挨着。相对的两个面不相挨：沿着这一排再隔一个找。

prompt.en: Which letter will be opposite A when the net is folded up?
prompt.zh: 展开图折起来以后，哪个字母和 A 相对？

guide.en: Fold it in your head with A as the bottom. The face opposite A closes the top.
guide.zh: 把 A 当底，在脑子里折一折。和 A 相对的面盖上顶。

hints.en: B and C both touch A when folded.
hints.zh: 折起来，B 和 C 都和 A 挨着。

hints.en: Look along the row that A is in: skip one square.
hints.zh: 沿着 A 所在的那一排看：隔一个。

correct.en: Yes. A and E are one apart in the row of 3, so they are opposite.
correct.zh: 对。A 和 E 在 3 个一排里隔一个，所以相对。

fallback.en: Not yet. That letter touches A when folded. Look one square further along the row.
fallback.zh: 还没对。折起来那个字母和 A 挨着。沿着这一排再隔一个找。

reveal.en: E is opposite A: A, D and E are a row of 3, and A and E are one apart.
reveal.zh: E 和 A 相对：A、D、E 是 3 个一排，A 和 E 隔一个。

say.en: D shares an edge with A, so they meet when folded. Opposite faces never touch: look one square further along the row.
say.zh: D 和 A 共用一条边，折起来一定挨着。相对的两个面不相挨：沿着这一排再隔一个找。

caption.en: A cuboid's 6 faces are rectangles in 3 pairs: top and bottom, front and back, left and right. The two faces in a pair are the same size.
caption.zh: 长方体的 6 个面是 3 对长方形：上和下、前和后、左和右。每一对的两个面一样大。

caption.en: Open it out on squared paper. The colours show the pairs: each rectangle has a twin with the same length and breadth.
caption.zh: 把它摊在方格纸上。同样的颜色是一对：每个长方形都有一个长、宽都一样的"双胞胎"。

caption.en: Rectangles that fold together must share an edge of the same length. The front, 3 by 1, meets the bottom, 3 by 2, along an edge 3 squares long.
caption.zh: 折在一起的两个长方形，接着的那条边要一样长。前面 3 × 1，底面 3 × 2，它们接在一条 3 格长的边上。

caption.en: Swap in a rectangle that is too short, and the box cannot close. It covers only half of its side, and a gap is left.
caption.zh: 换一个太短的长方形，盒子就合不拢：它只盖住那一面的一半，留下一条缝。

caption.en: Like a cube, a cuboid has many nets. Any of them works if the rectangles pair up and nothing overlaps when you fold it.
caption.zh: 和正方体一样，长方体也有很多种展开图。只要长方形配成对、折起来不重叠，就行。

keyFacts.en: A cuboid's net has 6 rectangles in 3 matching pairs.
keyFacts.zh: 长方体的展开图有 6 个长方形，配成 3 对。

keyFacts.en: Edges that fold together are the same length.
keyFacts.zh: 折在一起的边一样长。

keyFacts.en: A cuboid has many nets.
keyFacts.zh: 长方体有很多种展开图。

prompt.en: Siti is drawing a net of a 3 by 2 by 1 box. Choose the rectangle that finishes it.
prompt.zh: Siti 在画一个 3 × 2 × 1 盒子的展开图。选出能把它补完的长方形。

guide.en: Fold the 5 rectangles in your head. Which face is still open, and how big is it?
guide.zh: 在脑子里折这 5 个长方形。哪个面还空着？它有多大？

hints.en: The left end is 1 by 2. Its twin closes the right end.
hints.zh: 左端是 1 × 2。它的"双胞胎"盖住右端。

hints.en: The missing rectangle must meet an edge 2 squares long.
hints.zh: 缺的长方形要接一条 2 格长的边。

correct.en: Yes. A 1 by 2 rectangle on the right of the bottom closes the right end.
correct.zh: 对。底面右边接一个 1 × 2 的长方形，盖住右端。

fallback.en: Not yet. Fold it and look at the right end of the box. Which rectangle covers it exactly?
fallback.zh: 还没对。折一折，看盒子的右端。哪个长方形正好把它盖住？

reveal.en: The 1 by 2 rectangle beside the bottom is the twin of the left end, and closes the right end.
reveal.zh: 底面旁边那个 1 × 2 的长方形，是左端的"双胞胎"，正好盖住右端。

say.en: When folded, this rectangle has to meet an edge 2 squares long, but its edge is only 1. A gap is left. Each rectangle needs a twin the same size.
say.zh: 折起来，这个长方形要接一条 2 格长的边，它的边只有 1 格，留下一条缝。每个长方形都要有一个一样大的"双胞胎"。

say.en: There are 6 rectangles, but fold it and look: two of them land on the same face, and one face is left open.
say.zh: 确实有 6 个长方形，可是折一折看：有两个叠在同一个面上，另一个面空着。

prompt.en: This is most of the net of a tall box with square ends. Which rectangle finishes it?
prompt.zh: 这是一个两头是正方形的高盒子的展开图，还差一块。哪一块能把它补完？

guide.en: The four long rectangles wrap round as the sides. One end is closed already.
guide.zh: 四个长长的长方形绕一圈当四周，一头已经盖上了。

hints.en: The open end is a square, 2 by 2.
hints.zh: 空着的那头是 2 × 2 的正方形。

hints.en: It goes on the other end of the sides from the square that is there.
hints.zh: 它接在侧面的另一头，和已有的那个正方形相对。

correct.en: Yes. A 2 by 2 square at the top of the sides closes the other end.
correct.zh: 对。侧面上端接一个 2 × 2 的正方形，盖住另一头。

fallback.en: Not yet. Fold the sides into a ring. Which end is still open, and what size is it?
fallback.zh: 还没对。把侧面折成一圈。哪一头还空着？有多大？

reveal.en: The 2 by 2 square on top of a side closes the open end.
reveal.zh: 接在一个侧面上端的 2 × 2 正方形，盖住空着的那头。

say.en: When folded, this rectangle has to close a 2 by 2 end, but it is 2 by 3. It sticks out past the box. Each rectangle needs a twin the same size.
say.zh: 折起来，这个长方形要盖住 2 × 2 的一头，可它是 2 × 3 的，伸出盒子外面。每个长方形都要有一个一样大的"双胞胎"。

say.en: There are 6 pieces, but fold it and look: this square lands on the end that is closed already, and the other end is left open.
say.zh: 确实有 6 块，可是折一折看：这个正方形落在已经盖上的那头，另一头空着。

prompt.en: A net of a 3 by 1 by 2 box has one rectangle missing. Choose the one that finishes it.
prompt.zh: 一个 3 × 1 × 2 盒子的展开图少了一块。选出能把它补完的那一块。

guide.en: Find each rectangle's twin. The one without a twin tells you what is missing.
guide.zh: 给每个长方形找"双胞胎"。没有"双胞胎"的那个，告诉你缺什么。

hints.en: The 3 by 2 rectangle has no twin yet.
hints.zh: 那个 3 × 2 的长方形还没有"双胞胎"。

hints.en: Its twin must hang on an edge 3 squares long.
hints.zh: 它的"双胞胎"要接在一条 3 格长的边上。

correct.en: Yes. The 3 by 2 rectangle below the bottom is the twin of the 3 by 2 one above it.
correct.zh: 对。底面下面那个 3 × 2 的长方形，是上面那个 3 × 2 的"双胞胎"。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look for the rectangle with no twin, then find a place where its twin fits.
fallback.zh: 还没对。找出没有"双胞胎"的长方形，再找能放下它的"双胞胎"的位置。

reveal.en: A 3 by 2 rectangle under the bottom closes the front.
reveal.zh: 在底面下面接一个 3 × 2 的长方形，盖住前面。

say.en: When folded, this rectangle has to meet an edge 3 squares long, but its edge is only 2. A gap is left. Each rectangle needs a twin the same size.
say.zh: 折起来，这个长方形要接一条 3 格长的边，它的边只有 2 格，留下一条缝。每个长方形都要有一个一样大的"双胞胎"。

prompt.en: Which of these is a net of this 3 by 2 by 1 box?
prompt.zh: 哪一个是这个 3 × 2 × 1 盒子的展开图？

guide.en: Count the squares along each edge. Every rectangle needs a twin, and edges that fold together must be the same length.
guide.zh: 数一数每条边有几格。每个长方形都要有一个"双胞胎"，折在一起的边要一样长。

hints.en: Count the rectangles in each net.
hints.zh: 数一数每个展开图有几个长方形。

hints.en: Check that every rectangle has a twin of the same size.
hints.zh: 看看每个长方形是不是都有一个一样大的"双胞胎"。

correct.en: Yes. Its 6 rectangles make 3 pairs, and the edges that fold together match.
correct.zh: 对。它的 6 个长方形配成 3 对，折在一起的边一样长。

fallback.en: Not yet. Count the rectangles, and check the size of each one against its twin.
fallback.zh: 还没对。数一数长方形，再拿每一个和它的"双胞胎"比大小。

reveal.en: The net with 3 matching pairs folds up into the box.
reveal.zh: 配成 3 对的那个展开图能折成这个盒子。

say.en: When folded, one rectangle has to meet an edge longer than its own. A gap is left. Each rectangle needs a twin the same size.
say.zh: 折起来，有一个长方形要接的边比它自己的边长，留下一条缝。每个长方形都要有一个一样大的"双胞胎"。

say.en: A cuboid has 6 faces, so its net needs 6 rectangles. This one has 5: the box would be open on one side.
say.zh: 长方体有 6 个面，展开图要 6 个长方形。这里只有 5 个：盒子会有一面空着。

say.en: There are 6 rectangles, but fold it and look: two of them land on the same face, and one face is left open.
say.zh: 确实有 6 个长方形，可是折一折看：有两个叠在同一个面上，另一个面空着。

prompt.en: Which net folds up into this tall box with square ends?
prompt.zh: 哪个展开图能折成这个两头是正方形的高盒子？

guide.en: Count the squares along each edge. Every rectangle needs a twin, and edges that fold together must be the same length.
guide.zh: 数一数每条边有几格。每个长方形都要有一个"双胞胎"，折在一起的边要一样长。

hints.en: The box has 2 squares and 4 long rectangles.
hints.zh: 盒子有 2 个正方形和 4 个长长的长方形。

hints.en: The two squares must close opposite ends.
hints.zh: 两个正方形要盖住相对的两头。

correct.en: Yes. Four 2 by 3 sides and two 2 by 2 ends, one at each end.
correct.zh: 对。四个 2 × 3 的侧面，两个 2 × 2 的端面，两头各一个。

fallback.en: Not yet. Check that the two squares close different ends of the box.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看看两个正方形是不是盖住盒子不同的两头。

reveal.en: The net with one square at each end of the sides folds up into the box.
reveal.zh: 侧面两头各接一个正方形的那个展开图，能折成这个盒子。

say.en: There are 6 pieces, but fold it and look: both squares close the same end, and the other end is left open.
say.zh: 确实有 6 块，可是折一折看：两个正方形盖住同一头，另一头空着。

say.en: When folded, one rectangle has to meet an edge longer than its own. A gap is left. Each rectangle needs a twin the same size.
say.zh: 折起来，有一个长方形要接的边比它自己的边长，留下一条缝。每个长方形都要有一个一样大的"双胞胎"。

prompt.en: Which of these is a net of this 4 by 2 by 1 box?
prompt.zh: 哪一个是这个 4 × 2 × 1 盒子的展开图？

guide.en: Count the squares along each edge. Every rectangle needs a twin, and edges that fold together must be the same length.
guide.zh: 数一数每条边有几格。每个长方形都要有一个"双胞胎"，折在一起的边要一样长。

hints.en: The box has a 4 by 2 top and bottom, 4 by 1 front and back, and 2 by 1 ends.
hints.zh: 盒子的上、下是 4 × 2，前、后是 4 × 1，两头是 2 × 1。

hints.en: Count the rectangles, then check each pair.
hints.zh: 数长方形，再一对一对核对。

correct.en: Yes. 3 matching pairs, and the edges that fold together are the same length.
correct.zh: 对。3 对一样大，折在一起的边一样长。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look for 6 rectangles in 3 matching pairs.
fallback.zh: 还没对。找 6 个长方形、配成 3 对的那个。

reveal.en: The net with two 4 by 2, two 4 by 1 and two 2 by 1 rectangles, in the right places, folds up.
reveal.zh: 有两个 4 × 2、两个 4 × 1、两个 2 × 1、而且放对了位置的那个展开图能折成。

say.en: A cuboid has 6 faces, so its net needs 6 rectangles. This one has 5: the box would be open on one side.
say.zh: 长方体有 6 个面，展开图要 6 个长方形。这里只有 5 个：盒子会有一面空着。

say.en: When folded, one rectangle has to meet an edge longer than its own. A gap is left. Each rectangle needs a twin the same size.
say.zh: 折起来，有一个长方形要接的边比它自己的边长，留下一条缝。每个长方形都要有一个一样大的"双胞胎"。

prompt.en: What solid will this net fold up into?
prompt.zh: 这个展开图能折成什么立体？

guide.en: Look at the pieces: are they squares or rectangles, and do they come in pairs?
guide.zh: 看这些块：是正方形还是长方形？是不是成对？

hints.en: Count the squares along the sides of each piece.
hints.zh: 数一数每一块的边有几格。

hints.en: The pieces are rectangles in 3 pairs.
hints.zh: 这些块是长方形，成 3 对。

correct.en: Yes. 6 rectangles in 3 pairs fold up into a cuboid.
correct.zh: 对。6 个长方形配成 3 对，折成长方体。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look at the shape of each face, and count the faces.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看看每个面是什么形状，再数一数有几个面。

reveal.en: The net is 6 rectangles in 3 pairs, so it folds up into a cuboid.
reveal.zh: 展开图是 6 个长方形，配成 3 对，所以折成长方体。

say.en: Look at the faces: a cube has 6 squares all the same size. This box has rectangles on its sides, so it is a cuboid.
say.zh: 看面：正方体的 6 个面是一样大的正方形。这个盒子侧面是长方形，所以是长方体。

prompt.en: Two of these pieces are squares. What solid does the net fold up into?
prompt.zh: 这些块里有两块是正方形。这个展开图折成什么立体？

guide.en: A cube needs all 6 faces to be equal squares. Look at the other four pieces.
guide.zh: 正方体要 6 个面都是一样大的正方形。看看另外四块。

hints.en: The four long pieces are 2 by 3.
hints.zh: 四块长的是 2 × 3。

hints.en: A box with square ends and rectangle sides is still a cuboid.
hints.zh: 两头是正方形、侧面是长方形的盒子，还是长方体。

correct.en: Yes. Two square ends and four rectangle sides make a cuboid.
correct.zh: 对。两个正方形的端面加四个长方形的侧面，是长方体。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look at the shape of each face, and count the faces.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看看每个面是什么形状，再数一数有几个面。

reveal.en: The two squares are the ends; the four 2 by 3 rectangles are the sides. That is a cuboid.
reveal.zh: 两个正方形是两头，四个 2 × 3 的长方形是侧面。这是长方体。

say.en: Two pieces are squares, but the other four are 2 by 3 rectangles. A cube has 6 equal squares, so this net makes a cuboid.
say.zh: 有两块是正方形，可另外四块是 2 × 3 的长方形。正方体是 6 个一样大的正方形，所以这个展开图折成长方体。

prompt.en: The missing rectangle closes the right end of this box. How many squares long is its longer side?
prompt.zh: 缺的那个长方形盖住这个盒子的右端。它较长的那条边有几格？

guide.en: The right end is the twin of the left end. Count the squares along the left end's longer side.
guide.zh: 右端是左端的"双胞胎"。数一数左端较长的那条边有几格。

hints.en: Look at the small rectangle on the left.
hints.zh: 看左边那个小长方形。

hints.en: It is 1 square wide. How tall is it?
hints.zh: 它宽 1 格。它有多高？

correct.en: Yes. The ends are 1 by 2, so the longer side is 2 squares, the same as the edge it meets.
correct.zh: 对。两端是 1 × 2，所以较长的边是 2 格，和它要接的那条边一样长。

fallback.en: Not yet. Count the squares along the left end's longer side: the right end is its twin.
fallback.zh: 还没对。数一数左端较长那条边的格数：右端是它的"双胞胎"。

reveal.en: The ends are 1 by 2: the missing rectangle's longer side is 2 squares, to match the bottom's short edge.
reveal.zh: 两端是 1 × 2：缺的长方形较长的边是 2 格，和底面的短边一样长。

say.en: 3 squares is the length of the box, not of its ends. The right end meets the bottom along an edge 2 squares long, so it must be 2 squares too.
say.zh: 3 格是盒子的长，不是端面的。右端和底面接在一条 2 格长的边上，所以也要 2 格。

words.zh: 2 个三角形 + 3 个长方形 = 5 个面

caption.en: A prism has two ends that are the same shape and size, joined by rectangles. This triangular prism has 2 triangles and 3 rectangles: 5 faces.
caption.zh: 棱柱有两个形状、大小都一样的底，中间用长方形连起来。这个三棱柱有 2 个三角形、3 个长方形，一共 5 个面。

caption.en: Its net is 3 rectangles side by side, with a triangle above and below the middle one. The triangles fold in to close the two ends.
caption.zh: 它的展开图是 3 个并排的长方形，中间那个的上边、下边各接一个三角形。三角形折进去，盖住两头。

words.zh: 1 个正方形 + 4 个三角形 = 5 个面

caption.en: A pyramid has one base, and triangles that all meet at one point at the top. This square pyramid has 1 square and 4 triangles: 5 faces.
caption.zh: 棱锥有一个底，三角形的尖都碰在顶上的一个点。这个四棱锥有 1 个正方形、4 个三角形，一共 5 个面。

caption.en: Its net is the square with a triangle on each edge, like a star. Fold the triangles up and their tips meet at the top.
caption.zh: 它的展开图是正方形每条边上接一个三角形，像一颗星。把三角形折起来，尖就在顶上碰到一起。

words.en: prism: 2 ends + rectangles · pyramid: 1 base + triangles
words.zh: 棱柱：2 个底 + 长方形 · 棱锥：1 个底 + 三角形

caption.en: Both nets have triangles, so look at what else is there. Rectangles joining two equal ends make a prism. Triangles meeting at one point make a pyramid.
caption.zh: 两个展开图都有三角形，看看还有什么：用长方形把两个一样的底连起来的是棱柱；三角形的尖碰在一个点上的是棱锥。

keyFacts.en: A prism has two equal ends joined by rectangles.
keyFacts.zh: 棱柱有两个一样的底，用长方形连起来。

keyFacts.en: A pyramid has one base and triangles meeting at one point.
keyFacts.zh: 棱锥有一个底，三角形的尖碰在一个点上。

keyFacts.en: Count the faces in the net: it is the same as on the solid.
keyFacts.zh: 数展开图里的面，和立体上的一样多。

prompt.en: What solid will this net fold up into?
prompt.zh: 这个展开图能折成什么立体？

guide.en: Both prisms and pyramids can have triangles. Look at what else is in the net.
guide.zh: 棱柱和棱锥都可能有三角形。看看展开图里还有什么。

hints.en: Count the triangles. Are there rectangles too?
hints.zh: 数一数三角形。还有长方形吗？

hints.en: Two equal triangles joined by rectangles make the two ends of a solid.
hints.zh: 两个一样的三角形由长方形连起来，是一个立体的两头。

correct.en: Yes. Two equal triangles joined by 3 rectangles fold up into a triangular prism.
correct.zh: 对。两个一样的三角形用 3 个长方形连起来，折成三棱柱。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look at the shape of each face, and count the faces.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看看每个面是什么形状，再数一数有几个面。

reveal.en: The two triangles are the ends and the 3 rectangles join them: it is a prism.
reveal.zh: 两个三角形是两头，3 个长方形把它们连起来：它是棱柱。

say.en: Both kinds of net can have triangles, so look at what else is there. Rectangles joining two equal ends make a prism. Triangles meeting at one point make a pyramid.
say.zh: 两种展开图都可能有三角形，看看还有什么：用长方形把两个一样的底连起来的是棱柱；三角形的尖碰在一个点上的是棱锥。

prompt.en: What solid will this net fold up into?
prompt.zh: 这个展开图能折成什么立体？

guide.en: Both prisms and pyramids can have triangles. Look at what else is in the net.
guide.zh: 棱柱和棱锥都可能有三角形。看看展开图里还有什么。

hints.en: Look at the piece in the middle, then at the pieces round it.
hints.zh: 看中间那块，再看四周的那几块。

hints.en: When the triangles fold up, where do their tips go?
hints.zh: 三角形折起来，尖碰到哪里？

correct.en: Yes. A square base with 4 triangles whose tips meet at one point: a square pyramid.
correct.zh: 对。一个正方形的底，4 个三角形的尖碰在一个点上：四棱锥。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look at the shape of each face, and count the faces.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看看每个面是什么形状，再数一数有几个面。

reveal.en: The square is the base, and the 4 triangles meet at one point at the top: it is a pyramid.
reveal.zh: 正方形是底，4 个三角形在顶上碰到一点：它是棱锥。

say.en: Both kinds of net can have triangles, so look at what else is there. Rectangles joining two equal ends make a prism. Triangles meeting at one point make a pyramid.
say.zh: 两种展开图都可能有三角形，看看还有什么：用长方形把两个一样的底连起来的是棱柱；三角形的尖碰在一个点上的是棱锥。

prompt.en: Aisha folds this net of 4 equal triangles. What solid does she make?
prompt.zh: Aisha 折这个由 4 个一样的三角形组成的展开图。她折成什么立体？

guide.en: Both prisms and pyramids can have triangles. Look at what else is in the net.
guide.zh: 棱柱和棱锥都可能有三角形。看看展开图里还有什么。

hints.en: There are no rectangles in this net.
hints.zh: 这个展开图里没有长方形。

hints.en: Fold the three outer triangles up: their tips meet at one point.
hints.zh: 把外面三个三角形折起来：它们的尖碰在一个点上。

correct.en: Yes. One triangle is the base, and the other three meet at one point: a triangular pyramid.
correct.zh: 对。一个三角形当底，另外三个碰在一个点上：三棱锥。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look at the shape of each face, and count the faces.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看看每个面是什么形状，再数一数有几个面。

reveal.en: With no rectangles, the triangles fold up to meet at one point: it is a pyramid.
reveal.zh: 没有长方形，三角形折起来碰在一个点上：它是棱锥。

say.en: A prism needs rectangles to join its two ends, and this net has none. The triangles meet at one point, so it is a pyramid.
say.zh: 棱柱要用长方形把两头连起来，这个展开图一个长方形也没有。三角形碰在一个点上，所以是棱锥。

prompt.en: Here the triangles hang on different rectangles. What solid does the net fold up into?
prompt.zh: 这里两个三角形接在不同的长方形上。这个展开图折成什么立体？

guide.en: Both prisms and pyramids can have triangles. Look at what else is in the net.
guide.zh: 棱柱和棱锥都可能有三角形。看看展开图里还有什么。

hints.en: Count the triangles and the rectangles.
hints.zh: 数一数三角形和长方形。

hints.en: The rectangles wrap round and the two triangles close the ends.
hints.zh: 长方形绕一圈，两个三角形盖住两头。

correct.en: Yes. It is still 2 equal triangles joined by 3 rectangles: a triangular prism.
correct.zh: 对。还是 2 个一样的三角形用 3 个长方形连起来：三棱柱。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look at the shape of each face, and count the faces.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看看每个面是什么形状，再数一数有几个面。

reveal.en: The triangles close the two ends of the ring of rectangles: it is a prism.
reveal.zh: 三角形盖住长方形围成的一圈的两头：它是棱柱。

say.en: Both kinds of net can have triangles, so look at what else is there. Rectangles joining two equal ends make a prism. Triangles meeting at one point make a pyramid.
say.zh: 两种展开图都可能有三角形，看看还有什么：用长方形把两个一样的底连起来的是棱柱；三角形的尖碰在一个点上的是棱锥。

prompt.en: How many faces will the solid have when this net is folded up?
prompt.zh: 这个展开图折起来以后，立体有几个面？

guide.en: Every piece of the net becomes one face. Count all of them, whatever their shape.
guide.zh: 展开图的每一块变成一个面。不管什么形状，全都数上。

hints.en: Count the triangles, then the rectangles.
hints.zh: 先数三角形，再数长方形。

hints.en: 2 triangles and 3 rectangles.
hints.zh: 2 个三角形和 3 个长方形。

correct.en: Yes. 2 triangles + 3 rectangles = 5 faces.
correct.zh: 对。2 个三角形 + 3 个长方形 = 5 个面。

fallback.en: Not yet. Count every piece once: the triangles and the rectangles.
fallback.zh: 还没对。每一块数一次：三角形和长方形都要数。

reveal.en: 2 triangles and 3 rectangles: the prism has 5 faces.
reveal.zh: 2 个三角形和 3 个长方形：这个棱柱有 5 个面。

say.en: Those are only the triangles. Every piece of the net is a face, so count the rectangles too.
say.zh: 那只是三角形的个数。展开图的每一块都是一个面，长方形也要数。

prompt.en: Daniel folds this net into a square pyramid. How many faces does it have?
prompt.zh: Daniel 把这个展开图折成四棱锥。它有几个面？

guide.en: Every piece of the net becomes one face, including the base.
guide.zh: 展开图的每一块都变成一个面，底也算。

hints.en: Count the triangles, then the square.
hints.zh: 先数三角形，再数正方形。

correct.en: Yes. 1 square + 4 triangles = 5 faces.
correct.zh: 对。1 个正方形 + 4 个三角形 = 5 个面。

fallback.en: Not yet. Count every piece once, the square in the middle too.
fallback.zh: 还没对。每一块数一次，中间的正方形也要数。

reveal.en: 1 square and 4 triangles: the pyramid has 5 faces.
reveal.zh: 1 个正方形和 4 个三角形：这个棱锥有 5 个面。

say.en: Those are only the triangles. The square in the middle is a face too: it is the base.
say.zh: 那只是三角形的个数。中间的正方形也是一个面：它是底。

prompt.en: This net of a triangular prism has one triangle missing. Where does it go?
prompt.zh: 这个三棱柱的展开图少了一个三角形。它该接在哪里？

guide.en: The triangle already there closes one end. The missing one closes the other end.
guide.zh: 已有的三角形盖住一头，缺的那个要盖住另一头。

hints.en: The two ends are at opposite ends of the rectangles.
hints.zh: 两头在长方形相对的两端。

hints.en: Look at the bottom edges of the rectangles.
hints.zh: 看长方形的下边。

correct.en: Yes. A triangle on the bottom edge closes the second end.
correct.zh: 对。接在下边的三角形盖住了另一头。

fallback.en: Not yet. Fold it and look: that triangle lands on the end that is closed already.
fallback.zh: 还没对。折一折看：那个三角形落在已经盖上的那一头。

reveal.en: The triangle goes on the bottom edge of the middle rectangle, opposite the one on top.
reveal.zh: 三角形接在中间长方形的下边，和上面那个相对。

say.en: There are 5 pieces, but fold it and look: both triangles close the same end, and the other end is left open.
say.zh: 确实有 5 块，可是折一折看：两个三角形盖住同一头，另一头空着。

prompt.en: Ravi's net of a square pyramid has one triangle missing. Where does it go?
prompt.zh: Ravi 画的四棱锥展开图少了一个三角形。它该接在哪里？

guide.en: Each edge of the square base needs a triangle to fold up from it.
guide.zh: 正方形底的每条边上，都要有一个三角形折上去。

hints.en: Which edge of the square has no triangle?
hints.zh: 正方形的哪条边上还没有三角形？

correct.en: Yes. Now each edge of the base has a triangle, and their tips meet at the top.
correct.zh: 对。现在底的每条边上都有一个三角形，尖在顶上碰到一起。

fallback.en: Not yet. Fold it and look: that triangle lands on a face that is covered already.
fallback.zh: 还没对。折一折看：那个三角形落在已经盖住的面上。

reveal.en: The missing triangle hangs on the empty edge of the square base.
reveal.zh: 缺的三角形接在正方形底空着的那条边上。

say.en: There are 5 pieces, but fold it and look: this triangle lands on a face that is covered already, and one face is left open.
say.zh: 确实有 5 块，可是折一折看：这个三角形落在已经盖住的面上，另一个面空着。

prompt.en: Which of these is a net of this triangular prism?
prompt.zh: 哪一个是这个三棱柱的展开图？

guide.en: The prism has 2 triangle ends and 3 rectangles. The net needs all 5, with one triangle at each end.
guide.zh: 这个棱柱有 2 个三角形的底和 3 个长方形。展开图要有这 5 块，两头各一个三角形。

hints.en: Count the triangles and the rectangles in each net.
hints.zh: 数一数每个展开图里的三角形和长方形。

hints.en: The two triangles must be on opposite edges of the rectangles.
hints.zh: 两个三角形要在长方形相对的两条边上。

correct.en: Yes. 3 rectangles and a triangle at each end: it folds up into the prism.
correct.zh: 对。3 个长方形，两头各一个三角形：它能折成这个棱柱。

fallback.en: Not yet. Check the number of pieces, and where the two triangles are.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看看块数，还有两个三角形的位置。

reveal.en: The net with 3 rectangles and one triangle on each end folds up into the prism.
reveal.zh: 3 个长方形、两头各一个三角形的那个展开图，能折成这个棱柱。

say.en: The prism has 5 faces: 2 triangles and 3 rectangles. This net has only one triangle, so one end would stay open.
say.zh: 这个棱柱有 5 个面：2 个三角形、3 个长方形。这个展开图只有一个三角形，有一头会空着。

say.en: There are 5 pieces, but fold it and look: both triangles close the same end, and the other end is left open.
say.zh: 确实有 5 块，可是折一折看：两个三角形盖住同一头，另一头空着。

say.en: Both kinds of net can have triangles, so look at what else is there. Rectangles joining two equal ends make a prism. Triangles meeting at one point make a pyramid.
say.zh: 两种展开图都可能有三角形，看看还有什么：用长方形把两个一样的底连起来的是棱柱；三角形的尖碰在一个点上的是棱锥。

prompt.en: Which of these is a net of this square pyramid?
prompt.zh: 哪一个是这个四棱锥的展开图？

guide.en: The pyramid has a square base and 4 triangles that meet at the top.
guide.zh: 这个棱锥有一个正方形的底和 4 个在顶上相碰的三角形。

hints.en: Count the pieces in each net: the pyramid has 5 faces.
hints.zh: 数一数每个展开图有几块：这个棱锥有 5 个面。

hints.en: Look for rectangles. A pyramid's net has none.
hints.zh: 找一找长方形。棱锥的展开图里没有长方形。

correct.en: Yes. A square with a triangle on each edge folds up into the pyramid.
correct.zh: 对。正方形每条边上接一个三角形，折成这个棱锥。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look for a square base with a triangle on each of its 4 edges.
fallback.zh: 还没对。找一个正方形底、4 条边上各接一个三角形的。

reveal.en: The star, a square with 4 triangles round it, folds up into the pyramid.
reveal.zh: 星形的那个，正方形四周接 4 个三角形，能折成这个棱锥。

say.en: The pyramid has 5 faces: a square and 4 triangles. This net has only 3 triangles, so one side would stay open.
say.zh: 这个棱锥有 5 个面：1 个正方形、4 个三角形。这个展开图只有 3 个三角形，有一面会空着。

say.en: Both kinds of net can have triangles, so look at what else is there. Rectangles joining two equal ends make a prism. Triangles meeting at one point make a pyramid.
say.zh: 两种展开图都可能有三角形，看看还有什么：用长方形把两个一样的底连起来的是棱柱；三角形的尖碰在一个点上的是棱锥。

caption.en: Now a solid with a curved face. Cut a cylinder straight down its side and most of the way round its two ends, then open it out.
caption.zh: 现在看有曲面的立体。把圆柱的侧面竖着剪开一刀，两个圆形的底也沿边剪开大半圈，然后摊开。

caption.en: The curved face unrolls into a rectangle. The two circles stay joined to it, one on the top edge and one on the bottom edge.
caption.zh: 曲面摊开成一个长方形，两个圆还连在它上面：一个在上边，一个在下边。

words.en: long side = once round the circle

caption.en: The long side of the rectangle wraps once round the circle. So it is exactly as long as the distance round the circle, no shorter.
caption.zh: 长方形的长边正好绕圆一圈，所以它和圆一圈的长度一样长，短一点都不行。

caption.en: A cone opens into a circle and a shape like an open fan, not a triangle. The fan's curved edge wraps once round the circle.
caption.zh: 圆锥摊开是一个圆和一个像打开的扇子的形状，不是三角形。扇形那条弯的边正好绕圆一圈。

caption.en: Now you can name a solid from its net: circles mean a cylinder or a cone; rectangles with two equal ends mean a prism; triangles meeting at a point mean a pyramid.
caption.zh: 现在你能看展开图说出立体了：有圆的是圆柱或圆锥；长方形连着两个一样的底的是棱柱；三角形尖碰在一起的是棱锥。

keyFacts.en: A cylinder's net: a rectangle and 2 circles.
keyFacts.zh: 圆柱的展开图：1 个长方形 + 2 个圆。

keyFacts.en: A cone's net: a circle and a fan shape.
keyFacts.zh: 圆锥的展开图：1 个圆 + 1 个扇形。

keyFacts.en: The curved part wraps once round the circle.
keyFacts.zh: 弯的那部分正好绕圆一圈。

prompt.en: Which net folds up into this cylinder?
prompt.zh: 哪个展开图能折成这个圆柱？

guide.en: The curved face opens into a rectangle whose long side wraps once round the circle. Each end needs its own circle.
guide.zh: 曲面摊开是一个长方形，它的长边正好绕圆一圈。两头各要一个圆。

hints.en: Count the circles in each net.
hints.zh: 数一数每个展开图里的圆。

hints.en: Compare the long sides of the rectangles.
hints.zh: 比一比几个长方形的长边。

correct.en: Yes. Two circles, one on each long edge, and a rectangle that wraps once round them.
correct.zh: 对。两个圆，两条长边上各一个，长方形正好绕圆一圈。

fallback.en: Not yet. Check the number of circles, where they are, and the length of the rectangle.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看看圆的个数、位置，还有长方形的长度。

reveal.en: The net with a circle on each long edge and a long enough rectangle folds up into the cylinder.
reveal.zh: 两条长边上各一个圆、长方形够长的那个展开图，能折成这个圆柱。

say.en: This rectangle is too short: its long side would not reach all the way round the circle, and a gap would be left. The long side wraps once round the circle, no shorter.
say.zh: 这个长方形太短了：长边绕不满圆一圈，会留下一条缝。长边要正好绕圆一圈，短一点都不行。

say.en: There are two circles, but fold it and look: both are on the same edge, so they close the same end, and the other end is left open.
say.zh: 确实有两个圆，可是折一折看：它们在同一条边上，盖住同一头，另一头空着。

say.en: A cylinder has 2 flat faces, one at each end. This net has only one circle, so one end would stay open.
say.zh: 圆柱有 2 个平的面，两头各一个。这个展开图只有一个圆，有一头会空着。

prompt.en: Mei Ling wants to make this tall cylinder from card. Which net should she use?
prompt.zh: Mei Ling 想用卡纸做这个高高的圆柱。她应该用哪个展开图？

guide.en: The curved face opens into a rectangle whose long side wraps once round the circle. Each end needs its own circle.
guide.zh: 曲面摊开是一个长方形，它的长边正好绕圆一圈。两头各要一个圆。

hints.en: The circles can join the rectangle at different places along its edges.
hints.zh: 圆可以接在长方形边上不同的位置。

hints.en: Compare the long sides of the rectangles with the distance round the circle.
hints.zh: 拿长方形的长边和圆一圈的长度比一比。

correct.en: Yes. Its long side wraps once round the circle, and there is a circle for each end.
correct.zh: 对。它的长边正好绕圆一圈，两头各有一个圆。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look at how long each rectangle is, and how many circles it has.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看看每个长方形有多长，有几个圆。

reveal.en: The net whose rectangle wraps exactly once round the circle, with a circle on each long edge, folds up.
reveal.zh: 长方形正好绕圆一圈、两条长边上各有一个圆的那个展开图，能折成。

say.en: This rectangle is too long: its long side would go more than once round the circle, so the ends would overlap. The long side wraps exactly once round the circle.
say.zh: 这个长方形太长了：长边绕圆不止一圈，两头会叠在一起。长边要正好绕圆一圈。

say.en: A cylinder has 2 flat faces, one at each end. This net has only one circle, so one end would stay open.
say.zh: 圆柱有 2 个平的面，两头各一个。这个展开图只有一个圆，有一头会空着。

prompt.en: This cylinder is short and wide. Which net folds up into it?
prompt.zh: 这个圆柱又矮又宽。哪个展开图能折成它？

guide.en: The curved face opens into a rectangle whose long side wraps once round the circle. Each end needs its own circle.
guide.zh: 曲面摊开是一个长方形，它的长边正好绕圆一圈。两头各要一个圆。

hints.en: A short cylinder has a short rectangle, but its long side still wraps once round the circle.
hints.zh: 矮的圆柱，长方形也矮，可是长边还是要绕圆一圈。

hints.en: Where are the two circles in each net?
hints.zh: 每个展开图的两个圆在哪里？

correct.en: Yes. A circle on each long edge, and a rectangle that wraps once round them.
correct.zh: 对。两条长边上各一个圆，长方形正好绕它们一圈。

fallback.en: Not yet. Check where the circles are, and whether the rectangle is long enough.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看看圆的位置，还有长方形够不够长。

reveal.en: The net with one circle on each long edge and a rectangle exactly once round folds up.
reveal.zh: 两条长边上各一个圆、长方形正好绕一圈的那个展开图，能折成。

say.en: There are two circles, but fold it and look: both are on the same edge, so they close the same end, and the other end is left open.
say.zh: 确实有两个圆，可是折一折看：它们在同一条边上，盖住同一头，另一头空着。

say.en: This rectangle is too short: its long side would not reach all the way round the circle, and a gap would be left. The long side wraps once round the circle, no shorter.
say.zh: 这个长方形太短了：长边绕不满圆一圈，会留下一条缝。长边要正好绕圆一圈，短一点都不行。

prompt.en: Which net folds up into this cone?
prompt.zh: 哪个展开图能折成这个圆锥？

guide.en: The curved face of a cone opens into a shape like an open fan. It needs one circle for the base.
guide.zh: 圆锥的曲面摊开像一把打开的扇子。它要一个圆当底。

hints.en: Look at the edge of the big piece that wraps round the circle. Is it straight or curved?
hints.zh: 看大的那块要绕着圆的那条边。是直的还是弯的？

hints.en: Count the circles too.
hints.zh: 也数一数圆。

correct.en: Yes. A fan shape with a curved edge, and one circle for the base.
correct.zh: 对。一个带弯边的扇形，加一个当底的圆。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look for a fan shape with a curved edge, and only one circle.
fallback.zh: 还没对。找一个带弯边的扇形，而且只有一个圆。

reveal.en: The fan shape and one circle fold up into the cone.
reveal.zh: 扇形加一个圆，能折成这个圆锥。

say.en: The curved face of a cone opens into a shape like an open fan, with a curved edge. A triangle has straight sides, so it could not wrap round the circle.
say.zh: 圆锥的曲面摊开像一把打开的扇子，有一条弯的边。三角形的边是直的，绕不住那个圆。

say.en: A cone has only 1 flat face, the circle it stands on. This net has 2 circles, so one has no face to cover.
say.zh: 圆锥只有 1 个平的面，就是它立着的那个圆。这个展开图有 2 个圆，有一个没有面可盖。

prompt.en: Wei Jie wants to make this tall cone from card. Which net should he use?
prompt.zh: Wei Jie 想用卡纸做这个高高的圆锥。他应该用哪个展开图？

guide.en: The curved face of a cone opens into a shape like an open fan. It needs one circle for the base.
guide.zh: 圆锥的曲面摊开像一把打开的扇子。它要一个圆当底。

hints.en: The fan's curved edge must reach once round the circle.
hints.zh: 扇形那条弯的边要正好绕圆一圈。

hints.en: A triangle has no curved edge.
hints.zh: 三角形没有弯的边。

correct.en: Yes. Its curved edge wraps once round the circle.
correct.zh: 对。它那条弯的边正好绕圆一圈。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look for a fan shape whose curved edge is long enough to go round the circle.
fallback.zh: 还没对。找一个弯边够长、能绕圆一圈的扇形。

reveal.en: The fan shape whose curved edge goes once round the circle folds up into the cone.
reveal.zh: 弯边正好绕圆一圈的那个扇形，能折成这个圆锥。

say.en: This fan shape is too small: its curved edge would not reach all the way round the circle, and a gap would be left.
say.zh: 这个扇形太小了：它那条弯的边绕不满圆一圈，会留下一条缝。

prompt.en: Which net folds up into this cone?
prompt.zh: 哪个展开图能折成这个圆锥？

guide.en: The curved face of a cone opens into a shape like an open fan. It needs one circle for the base.
guide.zh: 圆锥的曲面摊开像一把打开的扇子。它要一个圆当底。

hints.en: How many flat faces does a cone have?
hints.zh: 圆锥有几个平的面？

hints.en: The curved face opens into a fan shape, not a triangle.
hints.zh: 曲面摊开是扇形，不是三角形。

correct.en: Yes. One circle and one fan shape: the cone's 2 faces.
correct.zh: 对。一个圆和一个扇形：圆锥的 2 个面。

fallback.en: Not yet. A cone has one flat circle and one curved face.
fallback.zh: 还没对。圆锥有一个平的圆和一个曲面。

reveal.en: One fan shape and one circle fold up into the cone.
reveal.zh: 一个扇形和一个圆，能折成这个圆锥。

say.en: A cone has only 1 flat face, the circle it stands on. This net has 2 circles, so one has no face to cover.
say.zh: 圆锥只有 1 个平的面，就是它立着的那个圆。这个展开图有 2 个圆，有一个没有面可盖。

say.en: The curved face of a cone opens into a shape like an open fan, with a curved edge. A triangle has straight sides, so it could not wrap round the circle.
say.zh: 圆锥的曲面摊开像一把打开的扇子，有一条弯的边。三角形的边是直的，绕不住那个圆。

prompt.en: Ravi drew this net for a cylinder. Will it fold up into a cylinder?
prompt.zh: Ravi 画了这个圆柱的展开图。它能折成圆柱吗？

guide.en: The rectangle rolls up into the curved face. Where do the two circles end up?
guide.zh: 长方形卷成曲面。两个圆会落在哪里？

hints.en: Look at which edge each circle is on.
hints.zh: 看每个圆接在哪条边上。

hints.en: A cylinder needs a circle at each end.
hints.zh: 圆柱两头各要一个圆。

correct.en: Yes. It will not fold up. Both circles are on the top edge, so they close the same end and the bottom stays open.
correct.zh: 对，不能。两个圆都在上边，盖住同一头，下面那头空着。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look at where the two circles are joined to the rectangle.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看两个圆接在长方形的什么地方。

reveal.en: It does not fold up: both circles are on one long edge. One circle must be on each long edge.
reveal.zh: 不能折成：两个圆在同一条长边上。两条长边上要各接一个圆。

say.en: There are two circles, but fold it and look: both are on the same edge, so they close the same end, and the other end is left open.
say.zh: 确实有两个圆，可是折一折看：它们在同一条边上，盖住同一头，另一头空着。

prompt.en: Farah rolls up this net. What solid does it make?
prompt.zh: Farah 把这个展开图卷起来。它成了什么立体？

guide.en: Look at the edge of the big piece. Is it straight or curved?
guide.zh: 看大的那块的边。是直的还是弯的？

hints.en: The big piece has a curved edge, like an open fan.
hints.zh: 大的那块有一条弯的边，像打开的扇子。

hints.en: It rolls up round the circle and comes to a point.
hints.zh: 它绕着圆卷起来，收成一个尖。

correct.en: Yes. A fan shape rolls up round one circle into a cone.
correct.zh: 对。扇形绕着一个圆卷起来，成了圆锥。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look at the shape of each face, and count the faces.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看看每个面是什么形状，再数一数有几个面。

reveal.en: The fan shape rolls up into a curved face, and the circle closes the bottom: a cone.
reveal.zh: 扇形卷成一个曲面，圆盖住底：圆锥。

say.en: A pyramid has a point too, but its sides are flat triangles. This piece has a curved edge, so it rolls into a curved face: a cone.
say.zh: 棱锥也有尖，但它的侧面是平平的三角形。这一块有弯的边，卷起来是曲面：是圆锥。

prompt.en: What solid will this net fold up into?
prompt.zh: 这个展开图能折成什么立体？

guide.en: Both prisms and pyramids can have triangles. Look at what else is in the net.
guide.zh: 棱柱和棱锥都可能有三角形。看看展开图里还有什么。

hints.en: Count the triangles, then look at what joins them.
hints.zh: 数一数三角形，再看是什么把它们连起来。

correct.en: Yes. Two equal triangles joined by 3 rectangles make a triangular prism.
correct.zh: 对。两个一样的三角形用 3 个长方形连起来，是三棱柱。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look at the shape of each face, and count the faces.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看看每个面是什么形状，再数一数有几个面。

reveal.en: The two triangles are the ends and the rectangles join them: a prism.
reveal.zh: 两个三角形是两头，长方形把它们连起来：棱柱。

say.en: Both kinds of net can have triangles, so look at what else is there. Rectangles joining two equal ends make a prism. Triangles meeting at one point make a pyramid.
say.zh: 两种展开图都可能有三角形，看看还有什么：用长方形把两个一样的底连起来的是棱柱；三角形的尖碰在一个点上的是棱锥。

prompt.en: Will this net fold up into a cube?
prompt.zh: 这个展开图能折成正方体吗？

guide.en: Choose a bottom, fold up the sides, then close the top. Does every face get exactly one square?
guide.zh: 先选一个底，把四周折起来，最后盖上顶。是不是每个面都正好有一个正方形？

hints.en: Choose one square as the bottom.
hints.zh: 先选一个正方形当底。

correct.en: Yes. Every face gets exactly one square: 2, then 3, then 1 is one of the 11 nets.
correct.zh: 对。每个面都正好有一个正方形：2 个、3 个、1 个的排法是 11 种展开图之一。

fallback.en: Not yet. Choose a bottom, fold up the sides, then close the top.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先选一个底，把四周折起来，最后盖上顶。

reveal.en: It folds up into a cube: it is one of the 11 nets.
reveal.zh: 能折成正方体：它是 11 种展开图之一。

say.en: This one does not look like the cross, but fold it: choose a bottom, fold up the sides, then close the top. All 6 faces are covered.
say.zh: 它不像十字形，但折一折：先选一个底，把四周折起来，最后盖上顶，6 个面都盖住了。

prompt.en: Choose all the nets that fold up into this cube.
prompt.zh: 选出所有能折成这个正方体的展开图。

guide.en: Some nets do not look like the cross. Test each one: choose a bottom, fold up the sides, then close the top.
guide.zh: 有的展开图不像十字形。每个都试一试：先选一个底，把四周折起来，最后盖上顶。

hints.en: Count the squares in each picture first.
hints.zh: 先数一数每幅图里有几个正方形。

correct.en: Yes. Three of them fold up; the 2 by 2 block and the two squares on the same side do not.
correct.zh: 对。有三个能折成；2 × 2 方块和同一边有两个的那个不行。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look for the quick signs, then fold the others in your head.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先找快速记号，再在脑子里折剩下的。

reveal.en: The row of 4 with one square on each side, the zigzag and the two rows of 3 are nets.
reveal.zh: 一排 4 个两边各一个的、阶梯形的、两排 3 个错开的，都是展开图。

say.en: This one does not look like the cross, but fold it: choose a bottom, fold up the sides, then close the top. All 6 faces are covered.
say.zh: 它不像十字形，但折一折：先选一个底，把四周折起来，最后盖上顶，6 个面都盖住了。

say.en: There are 6 squares, but fold it and look: two of them land on the same face, and one face is left open.
say.zh: 确实有 6 个正方形，可是折一折看：有两个叠在同一个面上，另一个面空着。

prompt.en: Draw a net of a cube on the squared paper: add 5 squares to the one that is there.
prompt.zh: 在方格纸上画一个正方体的展开图：在已有的那个旁边再加 5 个正方形。

guide.en: Any of the 11 nets is right. Choose a bottom, fold up the sides, then close the top.
guide.zh: 11 种展开图里哪一种都对。先选一个底，把四周折起来，最后盖上顶。

hints.en: Try a row of 4 with one square above it and one below it.
hints.zh: 试试一排 4 个，上面接一个，下面接一个。

correct.en: Yes. Your net folds up with every face covered once. Any one of the 11 nets is right.
correct.zh: 对。你的展开图折起来，每个面都正好盖住一次。11 种展开图里任何一种都对。

fallback.en: Not yet. Folded, two squares land on one face, and another face is left open.
fallback.zh: 还没对。折起来有两个正方形落在同一个面上，另一个面空着。

reveal.en: One answer: a row of 4 with one square above and one below. There are 11 different answers.
reveal.zh: 一种答案：一排 4 个，上面一个，下面一个。一共有 11 种不同的答案。

say.en: There are 6 squares, but fold it and look: two of them land on the same face, and one face is left open.
say.zh: 确实有 6 个正方形，可是折一折看：有两个叠在同一个面上，另一个面空着。

prompt.en: Tap the face that will be opposite the shaded face when the net is folded.
prompt.zh: 点出折起来以后和涂色的面相对的那个面。

guide.en: In a straight row, squares one apart are opposite.
guide.zh: 在一排里，隔一个的两个相对。

hints.en: Skip one square along the row of 4.
hints.zh: 沿着 4 个一排隔一个。

correct.en: Yes. The 2nd and 4th squares of the row are opposite.
correct.zh: 对。这一排的第 2 个和第 4 个相对。

fallback.en: Not yet. Opposite faces never touch. Look for a square that does not share an edge with the shaded one.
fallback.zh: 还没对。相对的两个面不相挨。找一个和涂色的面没有共用边的正方形。

reveal.en: The 4th square of the row is opposite the shaded 2nd square.
reveal.zh: 这一排的第 4 个和涂色的第 2 个相对。

say.en: These two squares share an edge, so they meet when folded. Opposite faces never touch: look one square further along the row.
say.zh: 这两个正方形共用一条边，折起来一定挨着。相对的两个面不相挨：沿着这一排再隔一个找。

prompt.en: This net folds up into a box with no lid. Tap the bottom of the box.
prompt.zh: 这个展开图折成一个没有盖的盒子。点出盒子的底。

guide.en: The row of 4 can wrap round as the sides. Which square is left?
guide.zh: 一排 4 个可以绕一圈当四个侧面。剩下的是哪一个？

hints.en: The square that is not in the row closes one end of the ring.
hints.zh: 不在那一排里的正方形盖住这一圈的一头。

correct.en: Yes. The row of 4 wraps round as the sides, and the square at the end is the bottom.
correct.zh: 对。一排 4 个绕一圈当四周，尽头那个正方形是底。

fallback.en: Not yet. That square is in the row of 4, which wraps round as the sides.
fallback.zh: 还没对。那个正方形在 4 个一排里，这一排绕成四周。

reveal.en: The square at the end, off the row of 4, is the bottom.
reveal.zh: 尽头那个不在 4 个一排里的正方形是底。

prompt.en: This net of a tall box with square ends has one piece missing. Choose the piece that finishes it.
prompt.zh: 这个两头是正方形的高盒子的展开图少了一块。选出能把它补完的那一块。

guide.en: The four long rectangles wrap round as the sides. Which end is still open, and how big is it?
guide.zh: 四个长长的长方形绕一圈当四周。哪一头还空着？有多大？

hints.en: The open end is a 2 by 2 square, at the bottom of the sides.
hints.zh: 空着的是侧面下端那一头，是 2 × 2 的正方形。

correct.en: Yes. A 2 by 2 square at the bottom of the sides closes the open end.
correct.zh: 对。侧面下端接一个 2 × 2 的正方形，盖住空着的那头。

fallback.en: Not yet. Fold it and look at the open end of the box.
fallback.zh: 还没对。折一折，看盒子空着的那头。

reveal.en: The 2 by 2 square under a side closes the bottom end.
reveal.zh: 接在一个侧面下端的 2 × 2 正方形，盖住下面那头。

say.en: When folded, this piece has to close a 2 by 2 end, but it is 2 by 1. A gap is left. Each rectangle needs a twin the same size.
say.zh: 折起来，这一块要盖住 2 × 2 的一头，可它是 2 × 1 的，留下一条缝。每个长方形都要有一个一样大的"双胞胎"。

say.en: There are 6 pieces, but fold it and look: this square lands on the end that is closed already, and the other end is left open.
say.zh: 确实有 6 块，可是折一折看：这个正方形落在已经盖上的那头，另一头空着。

prompt.en: Which net folds up into this cone?
prompt.zh: 哪个展开图能折成这个圆锥？

guide.en: The curved face of a cone opens into a shape like an open fan. It needs one circle for the base.
guide.zh: 圆锥的曲面摊开像一把打开的扇子。它要一个圆当底。

hints.en: Look for a fan shape with a curved edge, and count the circles.
hints.zh: 找一个带弯边的扇形，再数一数圆。

correct.en: Yes. A fan shape and one circle fold up into the cone.
correct.zh: 对。一个扇形和一个圆，折成这个圆锥。

fallback.en: Not yet. The curved face of a cone opens into a fan shape, and it has one circle.
fallback.zh: 还没对。圆锥的曲面摊开是扇形，而且只有一个圆。

reveal.en: The fan shape with one circle folds up into the cone.
reveal.zh: 扇形加一个圆的那个，能折成这个圆锥。

say.en: The curved face of a cone opens into a shape like an open fan, with a curved edge. A triangle has straight sides, so it could not wrap round the circle.
say.zh: 圆锥的曲面摊开像一把打开的扇子，有一条弯的边。三角形的边是直的，绕不住那个圆。

say.en: A cone has only 1 flat face, the circle it stands on. This net has 2 circles, so one has no face to cover.
say.zh: 圆锥只有 1 个平的面，就是它立着的那个圆。这个展开图有 2 个圆，有一个没有面可盖。
